summary:
Session 2026-11-17.

Session 2026-11-17 pre-open. Held META (10.5%), MSFT (13.4%) and PLTR (4.3%); cash is about 72%. No orders.

Context: Monday 11-16, SPY -1.9%, QQQ -2.7%, XLK -3.2%. The AI complex sold off on the NVDA fallout (Huang resigned, new export rules, board won't take him back). 10-year yield is about 5.1%, and a December Fed hike is about 91-100% priced. Premarket today is a mild bounce: QQQ +0.4%, NVDA +1.2%, AMD +2%, AVGO +1.1%, MSFT -0.4%, META -0.8%, PLTR +0.5%.

Key events:
- NVDA reports Q3 FY27 tonight after the close. Guide is $108B ±2%, consensus about $109.3B revenue and EPS 2.47, options imply about an 8% move. It is the first report since Huang left (interim CEO Kress). Risks: Q4 margin guide, China and export compliance, DOJ probes.
- Anthropic IPO prices Wed 11-18 evening (range $70-78, about $1.4T valuation, 6x oversubscribed) and debuts 11-19. AMZN and GOOGL hold large stakes in it. The new supply may be draining cash from the megacaps this week.

Decision: no trades. I have no edge over the options market on the NVDA binary. I don't pre-position on a gap or an unresolved headline (lesson from the NVDA stop-out). My three holdings show no fresh negative news (MSFT 365 outage and the META/Amazon/Google China data-center lobbying loss are noise). Candidates not traded: NVDA, AMD and AVGO (wait for the print), GOOGL and AMZN (no catalyst beyond the Anthropic stake; they fell on the sector selloff), AAPL and TSLA (no edge).

Next session:
1. Read the NVDA print, guide and market reaction. Then decide on NVDA, AMD and AVGO with the outcome known. Consider deploying cash if the AI complex stabilises, and AMZN/GOOGL around the Anthropic debut.
2. Check retail sales (11-18), the Anthropic pricing and 11-19 debut, and yields.
3. PLTR horizon ends 11-24, so close or extend it then. META and MSFT end 11-27.
4. Stops: META 571.8, MSFT 483.6, PLTR 143.
5. The Bessent deadline for NVDA is about 11-26.
notes:
Session 1 (2026-10-29): Started 100% cash. Bought MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO, AAPL, PLTR. Skipped AMZN/GOOGL/TSLA/AMD.
Session 2 (10-30): AMZN missed Q3, capex funding worry overrode capex plans. Held all.
Session 3 (11-02): Oct 30 QQQ -3.5%, SOX -7%. Held everything.
Session 11-06/09: NVDA stopped out -9.6% (gap through stop at open on CEO Huang affair / Megaspeed spy investigation headline). Lesson: stops don't protect against overnight gaps; key-man headline risk gaps. Small sizing (6.8%) limited damage.
Session 11-10: Mon 11-09 big rebound (SPY +2.4%, QQQ +3.5%). Did not chase after a big up day before CPI.
Session 11-11: QQQ +2.3%, XLK +3.2% (CoreWeave rebound). Held.
Session 11-12: NVDA -8% premarket on board weighing ouster of Huang. Did not trade (not holding, unresolved headline, no short chase after gap).
Session 11-16/17: Huang resigned; interim CEO Kress. Mon 11-16 SPY -1.9%, QQQ -2.7%, XLK -3.2% (NVDA -4%, AMD -5.6%, GOOGL -4%, AMZN -3.3%, PLTR -4.5%). Hawkish macro: 10y ~5.1%, Dec 8-9 Fed hike ~91-100% priced, Warsh chair. Held META/MSFT/PLTR (~28% invested, ~72% cash).

Event calendar (check each session):
- 11-17 after close: NVDA Q3 FY27 earnings (guide 108B+-2%, cons ~109.3B, EPS 2.47, implied move ~8%).
- 11-18: retail sales, Waller/Williams; Anthropic IPO prices evening (range $70-78, ~$64B raise, ~6x oversubscribed, ~$1.4T valuation).
- 11-19: Anthropic (ANT) debuts. AMZN holds ~14.7%, GOOGL ~13.7% post-IPO (AMZN stake ~9% of its cap, GOOGL ~4%). IPO supply may be draining cash from megacap AI names this week; earlier mega-IPOs (SPCX, CBRS) popped then faded.
- ~11-26: Bessent 10-day deadline for NVDA on China/Singapore compliance.
- 11-24: PLTR horizon ends. 11-27: META, MSFT horizons end.
- 12-03: TSLA/SpaceX 'more' (speculation). 12-08/09 FOMC.

Lessons:
- Don't buy/short after a gap on a single unresolved headline (NVDA 11-06 stop-out, 11-12 gap).
- Don't pre-position on a binary where I have no edge over the options market (NVDA print 11-17: 8% implied move; no read-through edge). Wait, then trade the reaction/clarity next session.
- Cash at 72% has beaten SPY/QQQ through the 11-16 selloff; no reason to deploy until the NVDA/Anthropic cluster resolves unless a clear dislocation appears.
- Wide daily swings (NVDA, AMD, PLTR +/-4-8%): stops need to be >= 10% on these.

Tools: web_search returns a JSON string (json.loads; must re-import json in every code run). read_page fails on CNBC and marketbeat; works on Fortune/Yahoo. get_quotes pre-open IEX shows gaps. scan 'earnings' column flags upcoming report dates.
Open questions: Does NVDA reaction transmit to AMD/AVGO/MSFT/META? Does a post-IPO ANT debut mark the bottom of the AI sell-off?

prompt:
Your universe is exactly ten stocks: NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, AVGO, AMD and PLTR,
plus cash. Nothing else is allowed.

- Your job is to decide how much of each of the ten to hold long or short, and when to hold cash
  instead, based on news and evidence about these companies, their suppliers, customers and
  competitors, and the macro events that move them.
- One of the benchmarks is these same ten stocks held at equal weight and never traded, so every
  trade you make has to beat doing nothing with the same names. Trading costs 0.10% per side.
- These are the most analysed stocks in the world. An edge, if there is one, comes from reading
  fresh information carefully and acting only when it changes the picture.
